num_iterations.tooltip: Number of times to execute the loop body.

start_iteration_index.tooltip: Index of the first iteration when using For loop mode.

max_iteration.tooltip: The exclusive stopping value for iteration_index in For mode.

step.tooltip: The index step size between each iteration when using For loop mode.

list.tooltip: List of items the loop iterates on. The loop body executes once per item.

cache_iterations.tooltip: Reuse unchanged iteration results from previous executions. Disable to execute every iteration again.

parent_iteration.tooltip: Connect iteration_index from an outer Start Loop to nest this loop.

initial_iteration_value.tooltip: Value exposed as current_iteration_value on the first iteration.

StartLoop.name: StartLoop
output_tooltips: Index of the current loop iteration.
True during the first iteration of the loop.
True during the last iteration of the loop.
Current item from the list when using List mode. None in Simple and For modes.
Loop-carried value for the current iteration: initial_iteration_value on the first iteration, then next_iteration_value from End Loop on each subsequent iteration.

use_cpu_cache.tooltip: Reduces VRAM usage, but slows the VAE down a lot

verbose.tooltip: Enables memory usage logging when using the model

combine_embeds.tooltip: Method to combine multiple clip embeds

tiles.tooltip: Use matteo's tiled image encoding for improved accuracy

GetImageRangeFromBatch.name: GetImageRangeFromBatch
GetImageRangeFromBatch.display_name: Get Image or Mask Range From Batch
GetImageRangeFromBatch.description: Returns a range of images from a batch.

accumulate.tooltip: Return output_value from every iteration when enabled; otherwise return only the final iteration.

output_value.tooltip: Value returned by End Loop. It returns the final iteration or all iterations according to accumulate.

next_iteration_value.tooltip: Value sent from End Loop back to Start Loop for the next iteration.

terminations.tooltip: Connect outputs that must execute on every iteration. Their values are not returned.

termination.tooltip: Connect a preview or side-effect output that must execute on every iteration. Its value is not returned.

EndLoop.name: EndLoop
output_tooltips: The final iteration's output_value, or values accumulated across iterations when accumulate is enabled.

videos.tooltip: Video segments to concatenate in input order.

codec.tooltip: Codec used to encode videos tensors. Auto uses H.264; already encoded videos remain unchanged.

complete_audio.tooltip: Optional complete soundtrack for the concatenated video. Overrides audio carried by the input videos.

ConcatenateVideo.name: ConcatenateVideo
ConcatenateVideo.description: Concatenates videos in order without decoding compatible encoded inputs.

enable_vae_tiling.tooltip: Drastically reduces memory use but will introduce seams at tile stride boundaries. The location and number of seams is dictated by the tile stride size. The visibility of seams can be controlled by increasing the tile size. Seams become less obvious at 1.5x stride and are barely noticeable at 2x stride size. Which is to say if you use a stride width of 160, the seams are barely noticeable with a tile width of 320.

tile_x.tooltip: Tile width in pixels. Smaller values use less VRAM but will make seams more obvious.

tile_y.tooltip: Tile height in pixels. Smaller values use less VRAM but will make seams more obvious.

tile_stride_x.tooltip: Tile stride width in pixels. Smaller values use less VRAM but will introduce more seams.

tile_stride_y.tooltip: Tile stride height in pixels. Smaller values use less VRAM but will introduce more seams.

model.tooltip: These models are loaded from the 'ComfyUI/models/diffusion_models' -folder

quantization.tooltip: Optional quantization method, 'disabled' acts as autoselect based by weights. Scaled modes only work with matching weights, _fast modes (fp8 matmul) require CUDA compute capability >= 8.9 (NVIDIA 4000 series and up), e4m3fn generally can not be torch.compiled on compute capability < 8.9 (3000 series and under)

load_device.tooltip: Initial device to load the model to, NOT recommended with the larger models unless you have 48GB+ VRAM

vram_management_args.tooltip: Alternative offloading method from DiffSynth-Studio, more aggressive in reducing memory use than block swapping, but can be slower

extra_model.tooltip: Extra model to add to the main model, ie. VACE or MTV Crafter

rms_norm_function.tooltip: RMSNorm function to use, 'pytorch' is the new native torch RMSNorm, which is faster (when not using torch.compile mostly) but changes results slightly. 'default' is the original WanRMSNorm

frame_window_size.tooltip: The number of frames to process at once, should be a value the model is generally good at.

motion_frame.tooltip: Driven frame length used in the long video generation. Basically the overlap length.

force_offload.tooltip: Whether to force offload the model within the loop for VAE operations, enable if you encounter memory issues.

colormatch.tooltip: Color matching method to use between the windows

tiled_vae.tooltip: Use tiled VAE encoding for reduced memory use

mode.tooltip: The sampling strategy to use in the long video generation loop, should match the model used

output_path.tooltip: If set, will save each window's resulting frames to this folder, also DISABLES returning the final video tensor to save memory

WanVideoImageToVideoMultiTalk.name: WanVideoImageToVideoMultiTalk
WanVideoImageToVideoMultiTalk.description: Enables Multi/InfiniteTalk long video generation sampling method, the video is created in windows with overlapping frames. Not compatible or necessary to be used with context windows and many other features besides Multi/InfiniteTalk.

images.tooltip: The images to create a video from.

audio.tooltip: The audio to add to the video.

bit_depth.tooltip: Auto uses 8-bit for sRGB and 10-bit for HDR. Explicit 8-bit and 10-bit choices are independent of colorspace.

color_space.tooltip: Colorspace of the input images. HDR selects BT.2020/HLG and HDR PQ selects BT.2020/PQ.

codec.tooltip: Optionally encode the video immediately. None keeps the images in tensor form; Auto uses H.264.

force_offload.tooltip: Moves the model to the offload device after sampling

riflex_freq_index.tooltip: Frequency index for RIFLEX, disabled when 0, default 6. Allows for new frames to be generated after without looping

samples.tooltip: init Latents to use for video2video process

batched_cfg.tooltip: Batch cond and uncond for faster sampling, possibly faster on some hardware, uses more memory

rope_function.tooltip: Comfy's RoPE implementation doesn't use complex numbers and can thus be compiled, that should be a lot faster when using torch.compile. Chunked version has reduced peak VRAM usage when not using torch.compile

start_step.tooltip: Start step for the sampling, 0 means full sampling, otherwise samples only from this step

end_step.tooltip: End step for the sampling, -1 means full sampling, otherwise samples only until this step

add_noise_to_samples.tooltip: Add noise to the samples before sampling, needed for video2video sampling when starting from clean video

duration.tooltip: Duration of the empty audio clip in seconds

sample_rate.tooltip: Sample rate of the empty audio clip.

channels.tooltip: Number of audio channels (1 for mono, 2 for stereo).

load_device.tooltip: Initial device to load the model to, NOT recommended with the larger models unless you have 48GB+ VRAM

start_index.tooltip: Start time in seconds, can be negative to count from the end (supports sub-seconds).

TrimAudioDuration.name: TrimAudioDuration
TrimAudioDuration.description: Trim audio tensor into chosen time range.

lora.tooltip: LORA models are expected to be in ComfyUI/models/loras with .safetensors extension

strength.tooltip: LORA strength, set to 0.0 to unmerge the LORA

low_mem_load.tooltip: Load the LORA model with less VRAM usage, slower loading. This affects ALL LoRAs, not just the current one. No effect if merge_loras is False

merge_loras.tooltip: Merge LoRAs into the model, otherwise they are loaded on the fly. Always disabled for GGUF and scaled fp8 models. This affects ALL LoRAs, not just the current one

normalize_loudness.tooltip: Normalize the audio loudness to -23 LUFS

multi_audio_type.tooltip: 'para' overlay speakers in parallel, 'add' concatenate sequentially

block_swap_debug.tooltip: Enable debug logging for block swapping
